title.value: The role of AI for MRI-analysis in multiple sclerosis—A brief overview
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned under the 'CITATION' section and in the paper header.

analysis.description: This paper is a mini review exploring the application of artificial intelligence in MRI-analysis specifically for multiple sclerosis. It highlights how AI can transform various stages of MRI analysis, such as data collection, lesion segmentation, detection, and volumetry, thereby improving diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning for multiple sclerosis.

type.justification: The paper reviews existing practical applications and studies that demonstrate the use of AI in MRI-analysis for multiple sclerosis, thus making it empirical.
type.quote:
In this short review, we explore the role of AI in MS applications that span the entire life-cycle of
an MRI image, from data collection, to lesion segmentation, detection, and
volumetry, and finally to downstream clinical and scientific tasks.

name.justification: The paper discusses the role of AI in MRI-analysis, which falls within the domain of medical imaging.
name.quote: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has played a crucial role in the diagnosis, monitoring and treatment optimization of multiple sclerosis (MS).

name.justification: The paper is specifically about the application of AI in the context of MRI-analysis for MS.
name.quote: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have underscored the potential for AI to not only improve, but also transform how MRI is being used in MS.

name.justification: The paper examines the application of AI in MRI-analysis, particularly for diagnosing and managing multiple sclerosis.
name.quote:
This review aims to introduce the reader to key areas in which AI is transforming MRI-analysis in MS (see Figure 1 for an
overview).
